main_body: A saddle seen in side profile (pommel and cantle with a dipped seat) resting on a thin brown rail, held up by two dark legs.
top_band: Peach saddle seat, rows 9-16. It reads as a curved profile silhouette (pommel left, cantle right, dip between), not a horizontal surface seen from above. No separate lighter band sits above a front face.
evidence: Reading down the middle column: peach saddle body (rows 9-16), then a brown skirt band with stud dots (rows 17-20), then a darker rail (rows 20-22), then the legs (rows 22-31). The saddle is a side-view silhouette whose seat is only an edge. The rack's rail and legs are flat front-view strips with no visible top face, and there is no front-edge line or eave shadow. The beam and base have no top surfaces, so this matches the guide's side-elevation and thin-seat failures.

style.evidence: The outline is a dark brown that leans toward the wood tone, so it is not a sticker look. The peach saddle body is a large, nearly flat fill with few highlight or grain dots, and the legs and rail are mostly 2-3 flat tones. The stall and the well in the references carry about 6 steps and per-element texture, and this piece is flatter and thinner beside them. The stud dots and the yellow accents are small details, not enough to offset the flat areas.
